# Kamil Wyremski

> Polish Full Stack Web Developer. Builds custom web applications and sells turn-key PHP scripts for classifieds, job boards, real estate, automotive, and directory websites.

## Web Scripts

- [Notice3](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/notice3): PHP & Symfony classifieds portal script with payments, social login, internal messaging, and map search.
- [Motonotice](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/motonotice): Automotive classifieds script with vehicle filters, photo galleries, and map integration.
- [Jobnotice](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/jobnotice): Job board script for employers and job seekers with CV uploads and paid postings.
- [Cuadro](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/cuadro): Real estate portal script with property listings, map integration, and contact forms.
- [Festa2](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/festa2): Events and directory listings script for business directories and regional events.
- [Holmes2](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/holmes2): Business directory script with profiles, ratings, and map search.
- [Demoty2](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/demoty2): Meme and viral media site script with voting, comments, and moderation.
- [Corta](https://wyremski.pl/en/script/corta): URL shortener script with analytics and click tracking.

## Services

- [Custom Projects](https://wyremski.pl/en/projects): Custom PHP and React web application development, script customization, SEO optimization.
